Which two words rhyme?
A) cat and cap
B) cat and bat
C) cat and cot

steps: 'cat' ends with /at/. 'bat' also ends with /at/. They rhyme. 'cap' ends with /ap/ and 'cot' ends with /ot/ — neither rhymes with 'cat'.
